$209,000, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,095 SF, MLS# 595218

Fully renovated and move-in ready — perfect for first-time homebuyers!
This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath home sits on a large corner lot in a quiet, established neighborhood and shines with modern upgrades throughout.

Step into a bright, open layout featuring brand-new flooring, fresh interior and exterior paint, and a fully renovated bathroom with stylish finishes. The kitchen has been completely updated with new cabinets, countertops, sink, and stainless-steel appliances, creating a warm, functional space for everyday living.

The spacious fenced backyard offers plenty of room for outdoor gatherings, play, or gardening, while the two-car garage provides added convenience and storage. Situated on a large corner lot, this home offers both curb appeal and extra space to enjoy.

Located close to schools, the hospital, shopping, dining, and Fort Cavazos (Fort Hood), this move-in-ready home combines comfort, style, and a great location — ideal for buyers seeking a home that’s beautifully finished and easy to love.

2 full bath
